title: Blind and Naked, This Newborn Bird Pushes Eggs Out of the Nest

scenes.text: Blind and naked, this chick pushes eggs from the nest.
It's a cuckoo, and the nest isn't even its own.
Its mother laid one egg in another bird's nest, after removing one of the host's eggs.
About ten hours after hatching, anything touching its back triggers a shove. It pushes the other eggs out, one by one.
Nobody teaches it. Scientists call it its very first instinct in life.
It can grow to ten times its foster parents' size, and they keep feeding it.

description:
Blind and naked, this chick pushes eggs from the nest.
A young cuckoo hatches in another bird's nest and, within hours, pushes the host's eggs and chicks out one by one.
What is the strangest instinct you know? Comment below.
first_comment: Why do you think the foster parents keep feeding the cuckoo anyway?
